§6Silicon Boule & Wafer Growth§f

§aThe raw crystal that becomes every processor in QMD. Grow it, slice it, dope it.§f

A Silicon Boule is grown in an NC Manufactory from silicon and hafnium. Then slice it into a Silicon Wafer using the Manufactory with a Boule Slicing Wire.

One boule gives one wafer. You need a lot of these. Wafer supply is the bottleneck for every processor tier, so set up bulk production early.

The wafer is a blank. N-Type doping happens in a Fission Irradiator. P-Type doping happens in a Target Chamber with Boron-11 ions. Both are mandatory for progression.

§ePS:§f Check JEI for the boule growth recipe. The hafnium comes from your Ore Leacher chain.
